items.title: Giga Storage secures €450M for Belgian BESS mega-project
items.summary: Owner-operator Giga Storage locked in a large financing package for its Green Turtle battery project in Belgium, one of Europe's biggest planned storage facilities at 700MW/2,800MWh. The deal underscores growing investor appetite for utility-scale long-duration battery assets in Europe.

items.title: Germany sees wave of BESS project deals and acquisitions
items.summary: Multiple European energy companies are ramping up battery storage activity in Germany, with TotalEnergies and Kyon, Envision Energy and Ju:niz, and Flower Infrastructure Technologies all announcing new project developments and portfolio acquisitions this week. The flurry of deals signals Germany is becoming one of Europe's hottest storage markets.

items.title: Frontier Power USA converts 920MWh Texas battery portfolio
items.summary:
Frontier Power USA exercised its selection right to bring four Texas battery storage projects developed by Stella Energy Solutions onto its platform, representing roughly 230MW/920MWh of capacity. 
The projects are expected to utilize Eos Energy Enterprises' Z3 long-duration batteries, with closing contingent on Eos's rights offering.

items.title: Tesla reports record 13.5GWh of storage deployed in Q2
items.summary:
Tesla announced it deployed 13.5 GWh of energy storage globally in Q2 2026, up sharply from the prior quarter and from Q2 2025, marking its second-largest quarterly total ever. 
The latest installations bring Tesla's total deployments to more than 132 GWh since 2016, placing the company on a trajectory to exceed its 2025 deployments.

items.title: Chinese integrators now control 76% of global BESS market
items.summary: New industry data shows Chinese battery energy storage system integrators cemented their dominance of the global market, capturing 76% of global market share in 2025. The figure highlights the widening gap between Chinese manufacturers and Western and other international competitors in the fast-growing storage sector.

items.title: Researchers crack the solid-state battery dendrite mystery
items.summary: Scientists say they have solved a key puzzle behind solid-state battery failures, explaining how soft lithium dendrites manage to crack the hard ceramic electrolyte and trigger short circuits. The findings, published in Nature, could help engineers design safer, longer-lasting solid-state cells for EVs and consumer electronics.

items.title: China finalizes first solid-state battery standard this month
items.summary: China officially published its GB/T solid-state battery standard for electric vehicles in July 2026, setting strict definitions and a weight-loss threshold of no more than 0.5% to qualify as true 'all-solid-state.' The standard bans marketing terms like 'semi-solid' or 'quasi-solid,' aiming to end definitional confusion as manufacturers race toward mass production.

items.title: Unigrid launches 25-year sodium-ion home battery in Europe
items.summary:
Battery maker Unigrid rolled out its NaCasa sodium-ion residential storage system in Europe, touting a 25-year lifespan and positioning it as a safer, mineral-independent alternative to lithium-ion home batteries. 
In the US, sodium-ion BESS is gaining momentum, with Peak Energy, ESS Inc, and Unigrid each announcing new steps to scale commercial deployment in 2026.
 A U.S. rollout is planned for later.

items.title: New organic sodium-ion cathode shows near-perfect cycling
items.summary:
Researchers detailed why a carbon-based organic material called DAAQ-TFP performs exceptionally well as a sodium-ion battery electrode. 
The material retains over 90% of its capacity after nearly 4800 cycles, charges and discharges quickly, and does so with high efficiency,
 offering a path to grid batteries less reliant on scarce metals.

items.title: Peak Energy to build first US grid-scale sodium-ion factory
items.summary: Sodium-ion startup Peak Energy is building a $71 million California factory described as the first US facility dedicated to grid-scale sodium-ion storage systems, with shipments expected to begin in early 2027. The move reflects accelerating momentum behind sodium-ion as a domestic, lower-cost alternative to lithium-based grid batteries.

items.title: New Jersey governor signs grid and data-center tariff bills
items.summary: New Jersey's governor signed a package of bills aimed at reshaping utility economics, including measures to cut transmission owners' return on equity, establish new data center tariffs, and require state approval for 'supplementary' transmission projects. The legislation reflects growing state-level pushback on rising grid costs tied to large load growth.

items.title: Queensland shelves AU$6 billion Mt Rawdon pumped hydro project
items.summary: The Queensland government has reportedly ended state support for the proposed Mt Rawdon pumped hydro project, a mine-repurposing scheme valued at roughly AU$6 billion that had previously received AU$50 million in government funding. The decision marks a setback for Australia's long-duration storage pipeline.

items.title: EU draft plan calls for 200GW of storage by 2030
items.summary: A leaked draft of the European Union's Electrification Action Plan states that the bloc must deploy 200GW of energy storage by 2030 to meet flexibility needs as electrification accelerates. The target would represent a dramatic scale-up from current installed capacity across member states.
